hook.name: IMX5V4Hook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook for IMX5 token pools that charges a 2.5% trade tax on the IMX5 leg of exact-input swaps (intercepted via beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas) plus a proportional LP fee share, accumulating ERC-6909 claims redeemable by an authorized bridge. Only owner-approved pools containing the IMX5 token are permitted to swap.
